newsitem.title: TURKMENISTAN: TURKMEN INFLATION SEEN BELOW 40 PCT FOR 1997.
newsitem.headline: TURKMEN INFLATION SEEN BELOW 40 PCT FOR 1997.

text.p: A senior official at Turkmenistan's central bank said on Friday inflation in the former Soviet republic would be less than 40 percent for 1997.
"At the moment, we are ahead of our own plan, with inflation for the first half of this year at 13 percent," Sergei Bogomolov, a senior analyst at the bank, told Reuters.
He said Turkmenistan had overcome hyperinflation, which totalled 1,362 percent in 1995 and 545.8 percent last year.
The economy in the desert nation of four million, rich in natural gas, is largely state run.
